passive.text: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **1.5/1.7/1.9/2.1/2.3**/s. When the equipper deals **Physical DMG** with an **EX Special Attack**, the Daze dealt by the equipper's attacks increases by **9/10.3/11.7/13/14.5%** for 10s, stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, all squad members gain **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%** additional CRIT DMG for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this CRIT DMG boost effect can exist in the same squad.

passive.name: Passionate Construction
passive.text:
While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s.
When using an **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Impact is increased by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 10s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Thick Broth
passive.text: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by **2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2%**, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Behemoth Hunter
passive.text: When the target's HP is no lower than 50%, the equipper inflicts **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** more Daze to the target. When the target's HP is no lower than 75%, this bonus is further increased by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

substatLine: CRIT RATE (until 100%) > CRIT DMG = ATK% > PEN > ATK

entries.name: Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Rock, Paper, Scissors
entries.text:
After **EX Special Attack: Rock** or **EX Special Attack: Scissors**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to two attacks, dealing **Physical DMG**.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

entries.name: Dodge: Line Busy
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Sudden Call
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Number Unavailable
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Forward Call
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Decline Call
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of **Assist Points** when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Back-to-Back Calls
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Performs a rapid dash followed by a slash attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Get Lost!
entries.text:
With **Customer Complaint**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Delivers a forward martial salute attack. On activation, it consumes 1 **Customer Complaint** and deals **Physical DMG**.
After activation, the previous character's **Quick Assist** is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Welcome Gesture
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Throws dual rings to slash enemies, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Rock
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Launches a fist attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Scissors
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Launches a scissors attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Paper!
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Launches a paper attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Welcome Mat
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches consecutive kicks against enemies in front, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Rushes forward and performs a finger flick attack, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Five-Star Service Hotline
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 **Positive Reviews**. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by **2** for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using **EX Special Attack: Rock**, the next **EX Special Attack** becomes **EX Special Attack: Scissors** for 8s.
After using **EX Special Attack: Scissors**, the next **EX Special Attack** becomes **EX Special Attack: Paper!** for 8s.
When **EX Special Attack: Paper!** hits an enemy, it applies the **Malicious Complaint** effect. While under **Malicious Complaint**, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by **30%**. Before recovering from Stun, **Malicious Complaint** can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with **Malicious Complaint** recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 **Positive Reviews** per second. When a heavy attack of **EX Special Attack: Rock**, **EX Special Attack: Scissors**, or **EX Special Attack: Paper!** hits enemies, she gains 7.5 **Positive Reviews**. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 **Positive Reviews**, when Dialyn triggers the **Chain Attack** window using **Chain Attack: Welcome Mat**, **EX Special Attack: Get Lost!**, or **Quick Assist: Forward Call**, the next character to switch in will have their **Chain Attack** upgraded to an **Ultimate**. When an ally launches an **Ultimate** this way, Dialyn consumes 60 **Positive Reviews**.
With at least 90 **Positive Reviews**, when Dialyn hits an enemy with **EX Special Attack: Get Lost!** and doesn't trigger a **Chain Attack** window, she consumes 90 **Positive Reviews** to forcibly trigger a **Chain Attack** window. The next character to switch in will have their **Chain Attack** upgraded to an **Ultimate**.
Each time **Positive Reviews** reaches 90 or an **Ultimate** is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 **Customer Complaint**. A maximum of 1 **Customer Complaint** can be held at a time.

entries.name: Additional Ability: External Line
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Attack** or **Rupture** character:
Dialyn's **EX Special Attack** CRIT DMG is increased by 50%.
When an **EX Special Attack** or **Ultimate** is activated, all squad members gain the **Overwhelmingly Positive** effect. While **Overwhelmingly Positive** is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an **EX Special Attack** or **Ultimate** while **Overwhelmingly Positive** is active, if the remaining duration of **Overwhelmingly Positive** is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from **EX Special Attack: Rock**, **EX Special Attack: Scissors**, or **EX Special Attack: Paper!** hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an **Attack** Agent, **EX Special Attack: Rock**, **EX Special Attack: Scissors**, and **EX Special Attack: Paper!** deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that **Attack** Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a **Rupture** Agent, **EX Special Attack: Rock**, **EX Special Attack: Scissors**, and **EX Special Attack: Paper!** deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that **Rupture** Agent's Sheer Force.

entries.name: Boundless Hospitality
entries.text:
The amount of **Positive Reviews** accumulated each second and gained when **EX Special Attack: Rock**, **EX Special Attack: Scissors**, or **EX Special Attack: Paper!** hits an enemy increase by 16%.
While the **Overwhelmingly Positive** effect is active, characters ignore 15% of enemy All-Attribute RES.

entries.name: 24/7 Hotline
entries.text:
Enemies affected by **Malicious Complaint** gain an additional 20% Stun DMG Multiplier when Stunned.
All units deal 15% increased DMG to targets affected by **Malicious Complaint**.

entries.name: Call From the Hollow
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: The Past Never Fades
entries.text:
Upon entering combat, Dialyn recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode.
While the **Overwhelmingly Positive** effect is active, Dialyn's ATK increases by 500.

entries.name: Lies
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Truth
entries.text:
When an ally enters the field with an Ultimate through the **Core Passive**'s effect, that ally gains the **Aftertone** effect.
With this effect, landing an attack causes Dialyn to deal an additional instance of **Physical DMG** equal to 480% of Dialyn's ATK.
This DMG is treated as **EX Special Attack** DMG, and can trigger once every second, up to 12 times.
Gaining **Aftertone** again refreshes its trigger count. Only one ally can have **Aftertone** at a time.
